headline: UPL Limited: Scheme of Arrangement
sum: Scheme of Arrangement - UPL Limited has informed the Exchange about receipt of Observation Letters from BSE Limited  and National Stock Exchange of India Limited in relation to Composite Scheme of Arrangement amongst the Company ( UPL 1 ),…
detail: Scheme of Arrangement - UPL Limited has informed the Exchange about receipt of Observation Letters from BSE Limited  and National Stock Exchange of India Limited in relation to Composite Scheme of Arrangement amongst the Company ( UPL 1 ), UPL Sustainable Agri Solutions Limited ( UPL SAS ), UPL Global Sustainable Agri Solutions Limited ( UPL 2 ), UPL Crop Protection Holdings Limited ( UPL Cayman 1 ).
